name: coverage-multi-target-dest-uncovered
body: coverage_check now inserts every operation edge target and every renames/moves destination (no last-wins slot), but the multiple-target-edges-per-task path has no unit coverage — coverage_check_reports_gaps_no_claims_and_verb_agnostic_touches exercises one destination only, and phase-5 task-15 owns its final rewrite. Limit: the second-destination path is unasserted. Upgrade: add the second-destination case to the coverage unit test when task-15 rewrites it.
